page.layout: One printed page of text, a division opener set in the centre of the page: an ornamental border, a large title block, a short line in italic and small capitals, and a second ornamental border below. The left edge carries a strip of text from the facing page, which is not transcribed here (it is a neighbouring page edge).

main_text.head: SECVNDA PARS EPISTOLAE D. PAVLI AD Hebræos.

page.notes: Faint show-through of the reverse page's running title and text is visible at the top and in the page body; it is not transcribed. The header ornament above the title is a decorative border with no text. The "§ 3" marker sits in the left margin beside the italic line. The left-margin strip belongs to the facing page and is not part of this page's text. The section mark and the italic "SECVN-" are a catchword-style opening of the next section, kept in the text as printed.
